_note: Walking demo biome catalog. Phase 4 shipped alpine-only; Phase 6 added forest as a second biome. Per spec 22 §Catalog schema: each biome has its own surface_slots + auto_biome_rules. The renderer (a) computes a per-fragment biome weight from auto_biome_rules elev+slope bands; (b) multiplies by the per-slot weight within that biome. Auto-rules: forest owns low-elevation flatlands, alpine owns higher/steeper. Crossover band ~5-15m elevation produces a natural transition (no hard seam).

selector._note: Phase 6 follow-up 2026-05-17: widened to cover full demo elev+slope range with 10m/10deg crossfades. Mid + rock still dominate via their own bands; ground is now the always-on baseline (no coverage gaps).
Mid slopes — lichen + moss on transitional rock. Phase 4.11.b: raised slope start to 25deg so mid only activates on real slopes; tightened bands to reduce bleed on near-flat ground.
High / steep — granite + lichen on exposed bedrock.

auto_biome_rules._note: Alpine owns mid-to-high elevation. Crossover with forest in [5, 15] m via 10m band. Outside this range alpine weight ramps down.

kernel._note: Forest uses the same NoiseStackKernel as alpine for the walking demo (single composed world). Phase 6 ships only material differentiation; per-biome kernel chains land in Phase 5.7 (KernelComposer).
